speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two oaths are out. By my holidame. God's me. By Jove stays, because he put it there. He signed. That is the whole of his pen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Seven shillings were counted at the priory. They were the company's. My coffer is shut. Edith's eight shillings is still owing till Lady Day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Richard the Third is at two, and I am not in it. Faustus is at the Rose. I am at this table. The letter is still the letter. I do not know the day.
